_comment: Register projects with: bin/pidev.js projects add <name> <absolute-path>. Paths are canonicalised (realpath) and must stay inside PIDEV_WORKSPACE_ROOT. A symlink that resolves outside the root is rejected unless the entry sets "allowExternalTarget": true AND "canonicalPath" to the exact resolved path (note: OpenACP's allowExternalWorkspaces=false still applies to the path you pass to /new). Projects must not be nested. repoUrl is informational only.
